title: “The valley wasn’t a detour — it was basic training.”
paragraphs:
“The valley wasn’t a detour — it was basic training.”
When you thought God left you in the dark, He was teaching you to see by faith. 🌄
Every storm. Every silence. Every setback — was strength in disguise.
Keep walking. You’re not lost… you’re being forged. ⚔️✨

“Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me.”
— Psalm 23 : 4 (KJV)
